messages:
sam: Heads-up: scheduling a maintenance for phx-12 (rack phx-12) on 2026-09-10 01:00 -> 02:30 UTC. Reason: swapped PDU and fan-array replacement in rack; we'll do staggered node drains to avoid imbalance. Ops please ack.

rita: ack. What's the expected transient capacity loss?

sam: Roughly 22% burstable for short intervals during primary PDU switchovers and fan spin-up. Dedicated tenants pinned elsewhere should be unaffected. We'll route short bursts to phx-hotspare if queue >70%.

noah: Canary plan: phx-12-node-04 first. Single-node canary, 20m observation, then 2-node cohorts (04+05 then 06+07...). Pause 12m between cohorts.

ops-oncall: I'll be on channel for the window. If any node fails to rejoin in >10m or p95 latency >30% of baseline, we halt. I'll enable temporary alerts on node-rejoin and thermal-oscillation.

infra-bot: Maintenance window created: 2026-09-10T01:00:00Z -> 2026-09-10T02:30:00Z (ID: mw-2069998888). Notifications scheduled.

sam: Runbook snippet to add:
```
# canary flow
kubectl cordon phx-12-node-04
kubectl drain phx-12-node-04 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --grace-period=120
pdu-switch --rack phx-12 --primary pdu-a -> pdu-b --verify
fan-array-replace --rack phx-12 --slot 2 --verify-rotation
reboot-node phx-12-node-04 --wait 300
health-checks --node phx-12-node-04 --checks net/tx, pcie, gpu-temp, kernel-logs
kubectl uncordon phx-12-node-04
# if health checks fail: revert PDU flip, mark nodes 'manual-investigate'
```

rita: We'll also pre-warm KV prefixes "/models/recall" and "/session/active" after each uncordon to avoid p99 spikes.

noah: KV warm commands:
```
phx-cache-seed --pool phx-gpu-pool --prefix "/models/recall" --workers 4
phx-cache-seed --pool phx-gpu-pool --prefix "/session/active" --workers 2
```

finance: Cost estimate if overflow to phx-hotspare used: approx $4.2k for 1.5h (preemptible + egress). Please confirm approval for contingency.

ops-oncall: Contingency approved up to $5k. I'll post temporary dashboards: p50/p95/p99, queue depth, tokens/sec, GPU evictions, node-rejoin-time, rack-PDU-metrics.

sam: Communication plan: status banner T-30m, #customer-success ping T-15m, email top-12 tenants with potential brief burst impacts. Console message: "phx-12 maintenance - PDU & fans".

rita: After each cohort annotate nodes: `kubectl annotate node phx-12-node-04 redwood/pdu=switched redwood/fan=slot2-v1` and upload logs (`dmesg`, `ipmitool sdr`, `nvidia-smi -q`) to s3://redwood-ops/maint/phx/2069998888/.

noah: One more request: run a short synthetic load (10m) on restored node to validate throughput and output quality before uncordon.

ops-oncall: Noted. I'll trigger synthetic-run and watch p99. If anything abnormal we rollback.

infra-bot: Reminder scheduled: 30m pre-notify at 2026-09-10T00:30:00Z.

sam: Thanks all. I'll paste final runbook link here an hour before start and update the rotation order. :white_check_mark:
